title: vcpkg version override
description: vcpkg.json declares an `overrides` entry that forces one port version. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `overrides` entry that forces one port version.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix an `overrides` entry that forces one port version.
limitation: It matches an `overrides` entry that forces one port version in the parsed vcpkg.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
